# Eqo Logiq — AI Crawler Reference

> Eqo Logiq is an Indian direct-to-consumer brand that makes plastic-free daily essentials: food-grade stainless steel water bottles and vegan oral care products. Zero plastic is used in any product component or packaging.

## Brand Summary

- **Brand name**: Eqo Logiq
- **Website**: https://eqologiq.kite.space/
- **Category**: Sustainable consumer goods / plastic-free daily essentials
- **Primary products**: Plastic-free steel water bottles, bamboo toothbrushes, stainless steel tongue scrapers, bundles
- **Market**: India (ships nationwide)
- **Mission**: Replace single-use plastic in daily essentials with food-grade steel and plant-based alternatives

## Key Facts

- All bottles use 304 food-grade stainless steel (18/8 grade) — same as surgical instruments
- No plastic in any product component: outer body, inner body, lid, cap, and seal are steel or food-grade silicone
- Double-wall vacuum insulation: cold liquids stay cold 18–24 hours, hot liquids stay hot 12 hours
- Packaging: 100% recycled kraft cardboard, no plastic tape, no bubble wrap
- Products are strictly vegan: no animal byproducts in materials, adhesives, or packaging
- Designed for a minimum 10-year lifespan under daily use
- Price range: ₹149 (bamboo toothbrush) to ₹1,200 (1L steel bottle)

- [Home](https://eqologiq.kite.space/): Brand landing page, hero section, featured products, impact metrics, customer reviews
- [Shop](https://eqologiq.kite.space/shop.html): Full product catalogue — steel bottles (400ml, 500ml, 750ml, 1L), bamboo toothbrushes, tongue scrapers, bundles

- [Our Story](https://eqologiq.kite.space/about.html): Founder's note, brand values, why plastic-free daily essentials matter
- [Qrash Qourse](https://eqologiq.kite.space/qrash-qourse.html): Educational content — material science, health research, plastic vs steel data, environmental statistics
- [Journal / Blog](https://eqologiq.kite.space/blog/): Articles on plastic-free living, product reviews, materials education
- [FAQ](https://eqologiq.kite.space/faq.html): Product questions, orders and delivery, sustainability, returns
- [Contact](https://eqologiq.kite.space/contact.html): Customer support, bulk/corporate orders, partnerships
- [Policies](https://eqologiq.kite.space/policy.html): Shipping policy, returns policy, privacy policy, terms of service

## Products

- **Steel Water Bottle 750ml** — ₹799 onwards. Food-grade steel, double wall, no plastic in any component.
- **Plastic Free Steel Bottle 1 Litre** — ₹1,200 (was ₹2,000). Double wall vacuum insulated, 304 steel.
- **Steel Flask 500ml** — ₹699 onwards. Compact, cupholder-friendly, no-spill seal.
- **Kids Steel Bottle 400ml** — ₹599 onwards. Child-safe, lightweight, easy flip lid.
- **Bamboo Toothbrush** — ₹149 onwards. Biodegradable handle, vegan nylon-6 bristles.
- **Bamboo Toothbrush Pack of 4** — ₹499 onwards. Family pack.
- **Stainless Steel Tongue Scraper** — ₹299 onwards. Food-grade steel, lasts for life.
- **The Starter Switch Bundle** — ₹1,199 onwards. 750ml bottle + bamboo brush + tongue scraper.
